messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Talk to your doctor if you feel more sensitive to pain.
Talk to your doctor if you have new pain after taking tramadol.
Important Information Guiding Use in Pediatric Patients:
Do not give tramadol to a child younger than 12 years of age or extended-release tramadol to anyone under 18 years.
Do not give tramadol to a child younger than 18 years of age after surgery to remove the tonsils and/or adenoids.
Avoid giving tramadol to children between 12 and 18 years of age who have risk factors for breathing problems.
These include having recently had surgery.
These include obstructive sleep apnea.
These include obesity.
These include severe lung disease.
These include neuromuscular disease.
These include taking other medicines that can slow breathing.
Pregnancy:
Tramadol may harm an unborn baby.
It is not usually recommended during pregnancy.
Use of tramadol for an extended period of time during pregnancy can cause withdrawal symptoms in your newborn baby that could be life-threatening if not recognized and treated.
Triplet: ["tramadol", "not recommended during", "pregnancy"]

The relation 'not recommended during' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is not typically advised for use during the specific period or condition described by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'should not be taken with': The subject drug is contraindicated or not recommended for concurrent use with the object entity.
B. 'not chemically related to': The subject drug is not chemically similar to or related to the substance specified by the object entity.
C. 'not interchangeable with': The subject drug cannot be substituted directly for the drug specified by the object entity.
D. 'does not act on': The subject drug does not exert its effects directly on the anatomical or physiological entity specified by the object entity.
E. 'not same as': The subject drug's effect is not the same as the event or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
